page.layout: One printed page: title page, all text centred in one column; an engraving (emblem with figures, a compass, a banner reading LABORE ET CONSTANTIA) in the middle; no margins with text.
page.notes: The engraving between "Vnà cum Notis," and "ANTVERPIAE," shows two allegorical female figures flanking a central compass resting on a plinth, with a ribbon banner inscribed "LABORE ET CONSTANTIA" (partly visible: "LABORE", "ET CONSTA", "NTIA"). Long s rendered as s; the italic line "Ad sacram profanámque historiam" and the next line "utiles." are as printed, the swash letters in "Vnà" and "Cum Privilegijs" are set in mixed italic type. The first title line is printed in capitals with spaced letters.
